content: Implement AgentMem 2.0 as a Claude Code plugin with skills, hooks, and slash commands instead of standalone CLI with manual hooks
title: AgentMem 2.0 as Claude Code Plugin

content: AgentMem persists Claude's native TodoWrite state automatically, restoring it in next session. No separate task system - TodoWrite IS the interface
title: TodoWrite persistence layer

content: When Claude exits plan mode, AgentMem skill auto-extracts tasks from plan, creates them in DB, and links to plan. Claude then works through tasks automatically
title: Plan to tasks automation

content: Support multi-repo workspaces: shared .agentmem/ at workspace root, local .agentmem/ per project. Context merges both. Use --global to save to shared
title: Workspace hierarchical memory

content: Single Qdrant container serves all projects but uses namespaced collections (agentmem_<hash>) for isolation. Hash based on project path
title: Qdrant collection per project

content: 1) Full automation - no manual commands needed 2) Persist Claude native features 3) Sub-agent coordination via task queue 4) Workspace support for multi-repo setups
title: AgentMem 2.0 goals

content: Phase 1 complete: Plugin at /Users/eagleisbatman/agentmem/plugin/ with 5 slash commands (remember, protect, sync, context, status), 2 skills (memory-persistence, plan-to-tasks), hooks.json, and MCP config. Test with: claude --plugin-dir ./plugin
title: AgentMem 2.0 Plugin Structure Complete

content: Implemented: Plugin structure (commands, skills, hooks), database schema (plans, sessions, todowrite_snapshots, task_history tables), services (plans, sessions, task history), CLI commands (plan CRUD, task update/history, session list/save-todos), MCP server with 10 tools. Ready for Phase 5 (init update) and Phase 6 (legacy hook removal).
title: AgentMem 2.0 Phase 1-4 Complete

content: All 6 phases implemented: Plugin structure, database schema (plans, sessions, todowrite_snapshots, task_history), services, CLI commands, MCP server (10 tools), init with plugin auto-install, legacy hooks deprecated. Pushed to GitHub.
title: AgentMem 2.0 Complete

content: Using .ok() on query_row swallowed 'no rows returned' error, causing silent failure and orphan history records. Always propagate errors for existence checks.
title: update_task_status silent failure

content: Added hierarchical .agentmem/ discovery (walk up tree), project-specific Qdrant collections (agentmem_{project_id}), and is_workspace_subdirectory() check. --global flag deferred as less critical.
title: Workspace support implemented

content: AgentMem skills should be installed to ~/.claude/skills/<name>/SKILL.md rather than the plugin directory, as Claude Code loads user skills from this location
title: Plugin skills install to ~/.claude/skills
